record.title: NXP PN7150 — high performance NFC controller with integrated firmware supporting all NFC Forum modes, NCI over I2C, HVQFN40 6x6 mm
record.why: IDENTITY READ OFF THE VENDOR'S OWN DOCUMENT. datasheet.pdf is NXP's PN7150 product data sheet Rev. 4.2 fetched 2026-09-02 from nxp.com (HTTP 200, 693641 bytes, sha256 in PROVENANCE.json); p.1 prints verbatim 'Rev. 4.2 — 2 February 2024 Product data sheet'. NOTE: nxp.com answered 404 to two plain curl attempts and to WebFetch; the third attempt with full browser headers (Accept, sec-fetch-*, Referer nxp.com) returned the PDF — the URL is right, the host gates bots. Every figure in electrical.chip.json is quoted from the file. WHAT THIS FOLDER IS: an NFC CONTROLLER CANDIDATE for the Microduck's two antennas; THE FITTED NFC IC IS CANNOT DETERMINE (docs/ELECTRONICS-AND-SOFTWARE.md §8). Sister candidate part:st25r3916. PASS means the part is exactly identified and its sheet is here; it does not claim the part is fitted.
record.subsector_why: open vocabulary; the sheet's own words: 'NFC controller with integrated firmware'.
record.lifecycle_why: for the HVQFN40 member only, on the sheet's own words: Table 2 marks the WLCSP42 member 'Do not use for new designs. Planned for discontinuation.' and says nothing of the kind about PN7150B0HN/C110xx; NXP's product page was not fetched.
record.origin_why: the manufacturer's own datasheet PDF was FETCHED from nxp.com and saved byte for byte as datasheet.pdf; PROVENANCE.json carries its sha256, size and URL.
record.standards_why: AS CLAIMED BY THE DATASHEET, not verified here: title 'supporting all NFC Forum modes'; §12.7.2 'ISO/IEC 18092, Ecma 340 NFCIP-1 communication modes'; §12.7.3.1 'NFC forum T4T, ISO/IEC 14443Acard mode'; Table 25 'In accordance with the Absolute Maximum Rating System (IEC 60134).' Protocol/rating-system standards, not a dimensional catalogue standard; no sourced offer — T4 not earned and not claimed.
record.used_by_why: no ce-elec board in this design names it; the HAT is the place an NFC controller would sit.
